# Allowed Languages

A shell script, a language the list leaves out:

```
#!/bin/bash
echo "Hello World"
```

A Ruby script, a language the list names:

```
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
puts "Hello World"
```

A language written in another case than its name in the list:

```Go
fmt.Println("Hello World")
```

A language written as the list names it:

```go
fmt.Println("Hello World")
```
